combo_label: The Pub × Coffee & Cafés × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Bristle circle of twenty numbered beds, ringed for doubles and trebles
Brass fitting on the bar counter that the draught beer flows from
Hargreaves who invented this cast of coloured shapes back in 1971
Breadcrumbed langoustine tails, served in a basket with chips
Bagged potato slices, plain and salted or done in cheese and onion
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Yellow Little Miss who brings smiles to gloomy Miseryland; warmth from above
Tall tapped cylinder keeping gallons of hot drink ready at a village hall.
Pink scribble of a Mr Man; how a toddler's bedroom looks after an hour alone
Degree of browning given to green beans, from pale blonde to near-black.
Espresso diluted with hot water, named after the drinkers it was said to suit.
Dark ale of modest strength, long the working man's everyday brew
Mid-morning pause for a cup and a biscuit, named after the hour it falls.
